overview_description.description: Zofeur is a mobility technology company that operates an on-demand chauffeur and driver services platform in the United Arab Emirates. The company provides app-based driver booking services that allow customers to hire trained drivers to operate their own vehicles for personal and business use cases. The platform supports services such as point-to-point transportation, airport transfers, vehicle pickup and drop-off for servicing, school transportation, vehicle inspections, and designated driver services.

about_short_description.short_description: Zofeur is a mobility and chauffeur service platform that allows users to book professional drivers on demand through a mobile application.

product.name: On-Demand Personal Chauffeur Service
product.description: A mobile-app service that matches customers with professional drivers to drive their own cars, with pay-per-minute or hourly booking options.

product.name: Car Movement Service
product.description: A driver-assisted vehicle pickup, drop-off, and transfer service bookable by the minute, hour, day, week, or month.

product.name: Zofeur Black
product.description: A monthly chauffeur subscription service designed to provide a dedicated or regularly available driver for individuals and families.

product.name: Zofeur Business Driver Services
product.description: An on-demand driver solution for businesses, including corporate transport, vehicle transfers, fleet support, and customer vehicle logistics.
